observed.caption: The entrance of the Kenyatta International Convention Centre with people on the stairs, flagpoles, banners and tall buildings in the background during daylight.
observed.description: A large concrete multi-level building with an orange sign reading THE KENYATTA INTERNATIONAL CONVENTION CENTRE above glass entrance doors is centered in the frame, with wide concrete stairs leading up to the entrance where several people are walking up and down and standing near the doors, tall silver flagpoles line the left and right sides of the plaza with two flags flying above the building including a Kenyan flag, vertical promotional banners stand on both sides of the stairs, a silver SUV is parked on the right near the stairs, potted plants and small trees flank the entrance, a tall glass skyscraper and a pinkish curved high-rise are visible behind the centre and a large angular concrete roof structure extends on the right, the sky is bright and overcast and the scene is lit by natural daylight.
